# Setup guide

LABELLED ENGINEERING FIXTURE: synthetic data, not a research result and not a recommendation.

Status: DRAFT until a validation attempt passes. Export 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d, run 9d8c7b6a-1111-4222-8333-444455556666.

Multi-Pine Bot with 2 member indicators. Exit contract: bridge-exit-v2. Same-bar order: exit-first-ordinal-v1.
Market: binance-global BINANCE:BTCUSDT Spot, standard candles, chart timeframe 1 (one minute).

## Member scripts

- Member 1: Fixture member 1, file members/1/indicator.pine, deployment 00000001-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-000000000001, source 7c9315291b2f.
- Member 2: Fixture member 2, file members/2/indicator.pine, deployment 00000002-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-000000000002, source d658c8b519fa.

## Shared Bridge pair

- Bridge atr_multiplier: 2 ATR multiple
- Bridge rr: 1.5 reward to risk ratio
The same pair applies to every member. No source input is selected in multi-Pine mode.

## Steps

1. Open a standard BINANCE:BTCUSDT Spot chart at timeframe 1. Each indicator stops with an error on any other chart type, symbol or timeframe.
2. For each member, create a new Pine indicator in TradingView and paste its indicator.pine completely and unchanged. Compile it and review every warning.
3. Match the two Bridge inputs of every indicator to the shared pair above and to inputs.json. All other source inputs stay at their stored values.
4. Disable native alert() calls of the source indicators through their existing inputs. If that is impossible, execution stays blocked.
5. Create exactly one alert per member deployment, 2 alerts in all, with the condition set to that member indicator and Any alert() function call. Enter the private webhook address shown by the application in TradingView only. Webhook addresses, keys and credentials are never part of this package.
6. Leave the alert message field as the alert() calls of the indicator set it. Do not edit or replace the message.
7. Missing verified bars wait up to five seconds without creating a Paper order. A timeout rejects the intent.
8. Protection is observed at bar close and starts on the next bar. SL wins over TP and over native exits.
9. Pine intents do not confirm inventory. The Paper worker controls accepted, capped and rejected fills and targeted exits. Cash, reservations and limits are shared by the Bot.
10. Replacing alerts requires a new deployment and preserved old exits.

No Quant support is implied by this package.

indicator("Fixture member 1", overlay=true)
len = input.int(11, "Length")
buySignal = ta.crossover(close, ta.sma(close, len))
sellSignal = ta.crossunder(close, ta.sma(close, len))


// Robot Trade bridge-exit-v2. DRAFT: compilation and Paper evidence required.
rt_93fb7cd44545_atrMult = input.float(2, "Bridge ATR Multiplier for SL", minval=0.000001, group="Robot Trade Bridge")
rt_93fb7cd44545_rr = input.float(1.5, "Bridge Risk-to-Reward", minval=0.000001, group="Robot Trade Bridge")
rt_93fb7cd44545_atr = ta.atr(14)
if not chart.is_standard or syminfo.tickerid != "BINANCE:BTCUSDT" or timeframe.in_seconds() != timeframe.in_seconds("1")
    runtime.error("Bridge requires the registered standard chart, symbol and timeframe")
var rt_93fb7cd44545_refs = array.new_string()
var rt_93fb7cd44545_times = array.new_int()
var rt_93fb7cd44545_stops = array.new_float()
var rt_93fb7cd44545_targets = array.new_float()
rt_93fb7cd44545_payload(string eventId, string eventType, string entryRef, string facts, int sequence) =>
    "{\"schema_version\":\"bridge-exit-v2\",\"deployment_id\":\"00000001-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-000000000001\",\"pine_import_id\":\"11111111-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-111111111111\",\"source_version\":1,\"broker\":\"binance-global\",\"symbol\":\"BTCUSDT\",\"timeframe\":\"1\"," + '"event_id":"' + eventId + '","event_type":"' + eventType + '","entry_ref":"' + entryRef + '","bar_time":' + str.tostring(time_close) + ',"sequence":' + str.tostring(sequence) + ',' + facts + '}'
if barstate.isconfirmed
    bool rt_93fb7cd44545_exitBar = sellSignal
    int rt_93fb7cd44545_sequence = 0
    if array.size(rt_93fb7cd44545_refs) > 0
        for rt_93fb7cd44545_i = array.size(rt_93fb7cd44545_refs) - 1 to 0
            if time_close > array.get(rt_93fb7cd44545_times, rt_93fb7cd44545_i)
                string rt_93fb7cd44545_reason = low <= array.get(rt_93fb7cd44545_stops, rt_93fb7cd44545_i) ? "SL" : high >= array.get(rt_93fb7cd44545_targets, rt_93fb7cd44545_i) ? "TP" : sellSignal ? "NATIVE" : ""
                if rt_93fb7cd44545_reason != ""
                    rt_93fb7cd44545_exitBar := true
                    string rt_93fb7cd44545_ref = array.get(rt_93fb7cd44545_refs, rt_93fb7cd44545_i)
                    alert(rt_93fb7cd44545_payload(rt_93fb7cd44545_ref + ":" + str.tostring(time_close) + ":EXIT", "EXIT", rt_93fb7cd44545_ref, '"reason":"' + rt_93fb7cd44545_reason + '"', rt_93fb7cd44545_sequence), alert.freq_all)
                    rt_93fb7cd44545_sequence += 1
                    array.remove(rt_93fb7cd44545_refs, rt_93fb7cd44545_i)
                    array.remove(rt_93fb7cd44545_times, rt_93fb7cd44545_i)
                    array.remove(rt_93fb7cd44545_stops, rt_93fb7cd44545_i)
                    array.remove(rt_93fb7cd44545_targets, rt_93fb7cd44545_i)
    if buySignal and not rt_93fb7cd44545_exitBar and not na(rt_93fb7cd44545_atr) and rt_93fb7cd44545_atr > 0
        float rt_93fb7cd44545_sl = math.floor((close - rt_93fb7cd44545_atr * rt_93fb7cd44545_atrMult) / syminfo.mintick) * syminfo.mintick
        float rt_93fb7cd44545_tp = math.ceil((close + rt_93fb7cd44545_atr * rt_93fb7cd44545_atrMult * rt_93fb7cd44545_rr) / syminfo.mintick) * syminfo.mintick
        if rt_93fb7cd44545_sl > 0 and rt_93fb7cd44545_sl < close and rt_93fb7cd44545_tp > close
            if array.size(rt_93fb7cd44545_refs) >= 1000
                runtime.error("Bridge intent capacity reached; review deployment")
            string rt_93fb7cd44545_ref = "00000001-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-000000000001:" + str.tostring(time_close) + ":0"
            array.push(rt_93fb7cd44545_refs, rt_93fb7cd44545_ref)
            array.push(rt_93fb7cd44545_times, time_close)
            array.push(rt_93fb7cd44545_stops, rt_93fb7cd44545_sl)
            array.push(rt_93fb7cd44545_targets, rt_93fb7cd44545_tp)
            alert(rt_93fb7cd44545_payload(rt_93fb7cd44545_ref + ":BUY", "BUY", rt_93fb7cd44545_ref, '"close":' + str.tostring(close, "#.################") + ',"atr":' + str.tostring(rt_93fb7cd44545_atr, "#.################"), 0), alert.freq_all)
